name: DocumentProjection
documentation:
Configures the independent public document projection maintained by a {@link Model} whose
 {@link Model#persistence() persistence} stores a document.

methods.name: collection
methods.documentation: Collection receiving current Model documents. Blank defaults to the resolved logical Model name.

methods.name: endPath
methods.documentation: Optional property path used as the document's end timestamp.

methods.name: searchable
methods.documentation:
Whether this current document is exposed through the Model's public search collection.

When {@code false}, Fluxzero does not expose the document through an unrestricted typed Model search. The direct document remains in {@link #collection() its normal resolved collection}, without a text summary, facets or sortable indexes, and is retrievable through exact parent or ancestor relationships. Model loads and verified current-state reads use a separate internal source. A Model that participates in Graph composition still maintains its independently required internal component indexes; use {@link io.fluxzero.common.search.SearchExclude @SearchExclude}, {@code @Facet} and {@code @Sortable} to shape those indexes explicitly.

This controls query visibility, not authorization, encryption or secret protection. Identity and related reads remain available to callers with store access; {@code @ProtectData} on an input message does not protect values copied into this document.

methods.name: timestampPath
methods.documentation: Optional property path used as the document's start timestamp.
